annotations.description:
Optional. Stores small amounts of arbitrary data.

**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the annotations present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_annotations' for all of the annotations present on the resource.
annotations.rationale: Annotations provide metadata for resource organization or automation. They do not influence authentication, authorization, or data protection mechanisms, so there is no direct security impact.

deletion_policy.description: This field uses a custom implementation please refer to documentation under /hashicorp/terraform-provider-google-beta/website/docs/r/firebase_data_connect_service.html.markdown for specifics
deletion_policy.rationale: Controls whether the service can be force-deleted along with its dependent resources. The secure direction is to disallow FORCE (keep DEFAULT) so that destructive cascade deletes are blocked unless dependencies are removed explicitly, preventing accidental data/loss. This matches the prevent-destructive-loss archetype.

display_name.description: Optional. Mutable human-readable name. 63 character limit.
display_name.rationale: The display_name is only a user-friendly label for ease of identification. It does not affect access control, authentication, or security enforcement.

labels.description:
Optional. Labels as key value pairs.

**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are used for categorization, billing, or resource grouping. They do not impact access control or security and are safe to configure for organizational purposes only.

location.description: The region in which the service resides, e.g. "us-central1" or "asia-east1".
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: The project attribute links the service to a Firebase/Google Cloud project. Security and access are controlled at the project level via IAM, not by this attribute directly.

service_id.description:
Required. The ID to use for the service, which will become the final component of the
service's resource name.
service_id.rationale: The service_id uniquely identifies the Firebase Data Connect Service. It has no direct security impact as long as appropriate IAM permissions govern access to the resource.
